notes: Merged #955 #944 #953 #954 #957 #946 #952 #956; closed #941 with evidence; closed #943 #949 #950 #951 by roast comments. Root cause of red main: ci.yml gated pip install/pytest on hashFiles(requirements.txt) with no root manifest. New finding: the test job was also path-filtered to source extensions, so docs-only PRs got test=skipped and update-ci-status.py correctly refused to certify -> CI Success red; fixed in #957 by making test unconditional, with agents-docs/CI_STATUS.md updated (that doc already said the skip was path-driven and must not be allowlisted). Ops learnings: GITHUB_TOKEN-triggered PR runs return action_required with no jobs (dispatch ci.yml on the branch instead); a bot keeps force-pushing Merge <sha> commits onto PR branches (re-fetch + --force-with-lease after every push); a commit message containing [skip ci] suppresses Codacy on the PR head, leaving the required check unreported and the PR BLOCKED (amend the message to drop it).
